# Bentley

## Overview

- **Role:** minister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

_Not yet known._

## Personality

Simon Bentley is known for his ability to compose and deliver exceptionally beautiful prayers. He is perpetually intoxicated or seeking to be, with his prayerful skill notably improving the more drunk he becomes.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)_

## Traits

- always drunk (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)</sub>

## Abilities

- making beautiful prayers (since v4)  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 8 MISS CORNELIA BRYANT COMES TO CALL P35](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0035)</sub>

## Goals

_Not yet known._

## History

Simon Bentley was a widower who served as the pastor of [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) for eighteen years prior to the arrival of his successor, Mr. [Allan](../character/allan.md). During his time as minister, he was known for delivering beautiful prayers while frequently drunk or hoping to be so.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P4](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P15](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXI.
